description: Kinds of business, for a business to say what it runs: each with its name in English, Portuguese (Portugal), Spanish, French and German, the setup it starts from (preset: appointments, trades, projects, food, bakery, cafe, shop, stays, or general, whose rules follow what agents can do), and the directory categories it falls under (slugs of vocab/categories.json). An inbox publishes a business's kind in its profile's categories: those slugs, and its name as a free tag; a kind the list lacks is the business's own words, as a free tag. A kind is never removed or renamed; new kinds come by a change to this file, which raises version.
